Trump claims ownership of the Moon, sparks online reactions

Former US President Donald Trump made claims of ownership over the Moon and posted images related to the US Space Force, including a uniform and an AI-generated picture of himself with a Green Lantern-style light. These posts, which also included claims over other territories like Greenland and the Panama Canal, generated a mix of mockery, praise, and disbelief online. International law experts noted that extraterrestrial bodies cannot be claimed under existing international agreements.
